freeInitialProfile.review: All Creatures of Our God and King。完整正文八个阅读区域与整曲转写对应，后续起点保持原有双窗口声学核对。整曲转写漏掉最初All，但两个无歌词提示的局部转写均逐字唯一识别All creatures of our开头，首词有正时长及概率依据，词尾与已知歌词窗口一致，两组实际起点在0.5秒内相符。

segments.text: O creatures of our God and King, Lift up your voice and with us sing,
Alleluia, Alleluia!
Thou burning sun with golden beam, Thou silver moon with softer gleam,
O praise Him, O praise Him, Alleluia, Alleluia, Alleluia.
Thou rushing wind that art so strong, Ye clouds that sail in heav'n alone,
O praise Him, Alleluia!
Thou rising morn in praise rejoice, Ye lights of evening, find a voice.
O praise Him, O praise Him, Alleluia, Alleluia, Alleluia.
And, O ye men of tender heart, Forgiving others, take your part,
O sing ye, Alleluia!
Ye who long pain and sorrow bear,
Praised God and on Him cast Your care. O praise Him, O praise Him.
Alleluia, Alleluia, Alleluia.
Let all things their Creator bless, And worship Him in humbleness.
O praise Him, Alleluia!
Praise, praise the Father, praise the Son,
And praise the Spirit, three in one.
O praise Him, O praise Him, Alleluia, Alleluia, Alleluia.
Amen.
